status: protocol frozen before candidate tuning; new locked corpus not yet acquired
scope: local audio measurement, synthetic speech detection, and separately validated manipulation localization
historical_v4_role: regression only; previously published and consulted

partitions.development: candidate selection, feature engineering and fusion fitting
partitions.calibration: disjoint source/speaker groups for score calibration, threshold and abstention selection
partitions.locked_test: new source/speaker groups; labels/results withheld from tuning; one final frozen-system evaluation
partitions.grouping: connected components of speaker, source utterance, cloning reference, duplicate audio and derivatives; no component crosses partitions
partitions.heldout: generator families and recording domains held out from development and calibration
partitions.unknown_provenance_policy: exclude from primary confirmatory results; disclose in exploratory results

synthetic_speech.primary_operating_point: threshold selected on calibration for empirical false-positive rate <= 0.01; frozen before testing
synthetic_speech.domain_policy: declare supported languages, duration bins, codecs and devices before locking; untested domains remain unsupported
synthetic_speech.uncertainty: paired connected-source-group bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 20261022; report class-empty draws; report speaker and generator sensitivity analyses
synthetic_speech.rare_error_policy: zero-error bootstrap intervals cannot establish low population risk; additionally report one-sided exact binomial upper bound using one prespecified recording per independent group; require both safeguards
synthetic_speech.probability_policy: no authenticity-probability claim without target-domain and prevalence validation

material_improvement_either: detection gain >= 0.02 at the same calibration FPR target with paired 95% gain lower bound > 0
false-positive reduction >= 25% relative at matched calibration detection target, paired 95% reduction lower bound > 0
promotion.no_exception_freeze: failed gates retain baseline; any revised protocol requires a new version and untouched test data

measurement.natural_audio_validation: annotated positives and confounder negatives; report event precision/recall and false alarms per hour
measurement.anomaly_promotion: paired improvement with 95% lower bound > 0 on prespecified event F1; false-alarm rate <= baseline; no edit-origin claim

localization.annotations: known alteration provenance, exact intervals and independent boundary review
metrics: boundary absolute error median and p95
false events per hour on unedited audio

resources.reference_environment: record actual hardware, OS, package versions, thread counts and device for every run
resources.timing: report cold model load separately; warm p50/p95 latency by recording duration and total runtime/audio duration
resources.acquisition: inventory local resources first; no automatic large downloads, training or paid compute

claim_gate: world-class requires comparable external results and independent replication; passing this internal protocol alone is insufficient
